title: RWX Agent-native CI/CD with Dan Manges
description:
This week on Remote Ruby, Chris, Andrew, and David welcome Dan Manges, co-founder of RWX and former CTO of Braintree, to explore a new approach to continuous integration built for the age of AI coding agents. Dan explains how RWX uses intelligent caching, graph-based execution, and isolated agent sandboxes to dramatically improve development workflows. They dive into flaky tests, automated code validation, security concerns, and why traditional CI platforms may be struggling to keep up with AI-driven development. Plus, they discuss how engineering teams can test changes before opening pull requests, reduce infrastructure costs, and rethink the way software gets built and shipped. Hit download now to hear more!
